scripts.dev: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && mkdir -p .data && concurrently --kill-others --names db,api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,blue "turso dev --db-file .data/lab-orders.db --port $TURSO_PORT" "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.dev:api: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && bun run --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.dev:web: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.db:generate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && bun run --cwd apps/api db:generate
scripts.db:studio: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && bun run --cwd apps/api db:studio
